clauses.clause: Act 1: the Lawton land district and the land office at Lawton, Oklahoma, are discontinued
Act 2: the lands within the Lawton district are transferred to and consolidated with the Guthrie land district
Act 3: the business and archives of the Lawton office are transferred to and made part of the land office at Guthrie

propositions.claim: The order was signed by President Taft at the White House on 17 August 1911.
propositions.quote: WM H TAFT THE WHITE HOUSE, Aug-. 17, 1911.

propositions.claim: The order rests on Revised Statutes sections 2248 and 2252.
propositions.quote: In accordance with the provisions of Sections 2248 and 2252 of the Revised Statutes of the United States, and by virtue of the authority therein given, it is hereby ordered

propositions.claim: The order's own sentence discontinues the Lawton land district and land office, a one-time abolition.
propositions.quote: The Lawton land district and land office at Lawvton, in the State of Oklahoma, be discontinued

propositions.claim: The same sentence transfers jurisdiction over the district's lands to the Guthrie land district.
propositions.quote: and the lands within said district transferred to, and consolidated with the Guthrie land district

propositions.claim: The same sentence transfers the office's business and archives to the Guthrie land office.
propositions.quote: and the business and archives of said land office transferred to and made a part of the land office at Guthrie, Oklahoma.
